editor.en: Here's BBC sports editor Dan Roan on World Service programme The Global Story.
editor.zh: 听听BBC体育编辑丹·罗恩（Dan Roan）在世界服务节目《全球故事》中的看法。

editor.en: His editor suggested Orwell remove the entire second half altogether.
editor.zh: 他的编辑建议奥威尔把后半部分全部删掉。

editor.en: Adline Okere is BBC Igbo news editor in Lagos, Nigeria.
editor.zh: Adline Okere 是尼日利亚拉各斯的 BBC Igbo 新闻编辑。

editor.en: The editor of Gay News, Denis Lemon, was convicted.
editor.zh: 《Gay News》的主编 Denis Lemon 被判有罪。

editor.en: I was editor of the creative writing magazine.
editor.zh: 我是创意写作杂志的编辑。

edible.en: Yes, that's right. In some parts of the world, edible insects are crunched too.
edible.zh: 是的，没错。在世界某些地方，可食用的昆虫也是嘎吱嘎吱吃的。

edible.en: She'd been inspired by botanical cuisine, the use of edible flowers and herbs to decorate and flavour food.
edible.zh: 她受到了植物料理（botanical cuisine）的启发，即使用食用花卉和草药来装饰食物并为其调味。

edible.en: With around 5,000 varieties, 300 of which are edible, mushrooms are an important part of traditional Japanese cooking.
edible.zh: 日本有大约 5000 个品种，其中 300 种可食用，蘑菇是日本传统烹饪的重要组成部分。

edible.en: Scanning means searching a wide area with your eyes to find some particular thing – in this case, edible plants and herbs.
edible.zh: “观察”（Scanning）意味着用眼睛搜索广阔的区域以寻找特定的东西——在这种情况下，是可食用的植物和草药。

edit.en: Andie Sophia Fontaine, who used to work in McDonald’s, now edits The Iceland Review.
edit.zh: Andie Sophia Fontaine 曾经在 McDonald’s 工作过，现在是《冰岛评论》的编辑。

edit.en: It was edited by Tara Boyle. We had original music this week from Ramtin Arablouei.
edit.zh: 本期节目由 Tara Boyle 剪辑。本期我们的原创音乐来自 Ramtin Arablouei。

edit.en: They checked information, edited articles, and tried to maintain certain standards of accuracy.
edit.zh: 他们核实信息、编辑文章，并努力维持一定的准确性标准。

edit.en: It sounds like what they are. You have this idea of ruthless edit.
edit.zh: 你能解释一下那是什么吗？

edit.en: Aura farming is when people post highly edited or curated photos online to boost their image.
edit.zh: Aura farming 指的是人们在网上发布经过精心修饰、刻意打造的照片，以此来提升自己的形象。

edition.en: He spent much of his later career inserting fake notes and fake documents into early Shakespeare editions, and getting caught doing so.
edition.zh: 他的后半生很大一部分时间都在早期的莎士比亚版本中塞入虚假的笔记和虚假的文件，并因此被抓包。

editorial.en: That’s the editorial side. And some dictionaries even add a third element.
editorial.zh: 这就是编辑判断的一面。而有些词典甚至还会加入第三个环节。

editorial.en: But broadly speaking, it’s a combination of data and editorial judgement.
editorial.zh: 但总体来说，这是数据分析和编辑判断相结合的结果。

editorial.en: Or if you're more of a Wall Street Journal editorial page type, an innocent mortgage banker who was duped by lying, greedy homeowner.
editorial.zh: 或者如果你更倾向于《华尔街日报》社论版的口味，那就是一个被说谎、贪婪的房主欺骗的无辜房贷银行家。

edge.en: But if you’re not operating near the edge of your current ability, you’re not making serious progress.
edge.zh: 但如果你没有在当前能力的边缘运作，你就没有取得实质性的进展。

edge.en: Terms for the “road”, terms for “lanes”, terms for the “shoulder” at the edge of a road.
edge.zh: 关于“道路”的术语，“车道”的术语，路边缘“路肩”的术语。

edge.en: And in early 1692, life gave them plenty of reasons to feel that the devil was edging closer.
edge.zh: 而在1692年初，生活给他们提供了充足的理由，让他们觉得魔鬼正在步步逼近。

edge.en: It was harder for me to remember. It was probably at the edge of my ability, and I forgot my words.
edge.zh: 这对我来说更难记住。它可能已经达到了我能力边缘，结果我忘词了。

edge.en: In interactions with others, this gives them an edge.
edge.zh: 在与他人的互动中，这会给他们带来明显的优势。
